data.name: Istighna
data.gender_notes: Istighna is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: A name derived from the Arabic word ‘Istighna’ which means ‘to seek help’, ‘to ask for forgiveness’, ‘to turn to Allah for aid and support’. It is a beautiful name for a baby girl, reflecting the deep spirituality and faith of her parents, as they entrust her future to the care and guidance of the Almighty. The name Istighna carries the meaning “Seeking Help, Asking For Forgiveness” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic. Parents who choose Istighna usually hope their child will grow to embody seeking help, asking for forgiveness and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name that signifies the deep longing and yearning of the heart to seek closeness with the Divine, to turn towards Allah in times of need and distress, and to ask for His mercy and forgiveness. It is a name that embodies the essence of faith, devotion, and surrender.
data.etymology: Istighna belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Seeking Help, Asking For Forgiveness.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Istighna total 6, giving a life-path number of 6. Number 6 is linked with Venus and with the qualities of responsibility, care and community.

in_arabic.name: استغنى
in_arabic.meaning: الاستغناء من الغنى، كفاية المال، والاكتفاء الذاتي
in_arabic.long_meaning: اسم مشتق من غنى، ويعني كفاية الشخص عن الآخرين، وعدم الحاجة إلى أحد، كما يشير إلى الاكتفاء الذاتي والغنى الداخلي، وقد ورد في القرآن الكريم في سياق الحديث عن الغنى والفقر، واستخدام هذا الاسم يدل على صفة محمودة وهي الاستغناء عن الناس والاعتماد على الله

in_urdu.name: استغنی
in_urdu.meaning: مال کی کفایت، خود کفائی، اور مالی آزادی
in_urdu.long_meaning: یہ نام عربی زبان کے 'غنی' سے ماخوذ ہے، جس کا مطلب ہے مال کی کفایت اور خود کفائی، اسلامی تقویم میں یہ نام ان خصوصیات کو ظاہر کرتا ہے جو ایک فرد کو دوسروں سے آزاد اور مالی طور پر خود کفیل بناتی ہیں، تاریخی طور پر، یہ نام ان لوگوں کے لئے استعمال کیا جاتا رہا ہے جو اپنے مالی معاملات میں آزاد اور خود کفیل ہیں
